Title: [LSJ] Ira Rivers and Telepathic Vote Counting

Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
I have a question regarding the Toreador prince Ira Rivers with the special
ability (stated from card text) :
When Ira plays a card requiring Auspex , you may draw an additional card
from your library (discard down to your hand size afterwards).

What happens if Ira successfully calls a referendum (action wise
successfull) and plays a Telepathic Vote Counting ? The TVC cannot be
replaced but can I draw an additional card ? Or is that after the referendum
?

johannes walch
v:ekn germany

Messages.Author: henrik ericsson
Messages.Body:
"Johannes Walch" <johanne...@vekn.de> wrote in message news:<b7u23q$gdt$1...@stu1id2.ip.tesion.net>...


IANLSJ :(

But I would think that since the ability doesn't say that you should
draw the additional card when you replace, you get to draw one card
and then discard down to your hand size (which is one smaller since
cards you don't replace counts towards your handsize).

But I'm not too sure.

Messages.Author: Michael Deflize
Messages.Body:
"Johannes Walch" <johanne...@vekn.de> wrote in message news:<b7u23q$gdt$1...@stu1id2.ip.tesion.net>...



From the rulebook:
Important: No Methuselahs draw to replace cards during a referendum.
After the referendum, each Methuselah draws back up to her hand size
(as necessary).

I would say you may draw the additional card immediately (since it
does not have anything to do with replacing the card, but is an
effect that comes from the playing of the auspex card), and then
discard one card if you chose to draw one, down to your handsize again
(counting the not yet replaced card/cards, of course).

Michael

This question was asked before and from my memory LSJ said that you would
use Ira's special ability when you actually DO replace the card. So after
the referendum instead of drawing 1 card to replace the TCV, you would draw
2 cards to replace and then discard 1 as per Ira's special.

Of course I could be wrong....
